sayLines.line: 📖 LEARNED: Fire in Rain (Level 2). Birch bark burns wet. Pine resin is nature's firestarter. Look for fatwood in old stumps.
📖 LEARNED: Managing Fear (Level 2). You can function through terror. Your hands shake but they work. This is a trained skill.
📖 LEARNED: Draw Fire (Level 2). Your challenge carries further. Beasts hear it first.
📖 LEARNED: Rally (Level 2). Your voice finds them faster in the noise.
📖 Your old life taught you things. 4 skills from your past — check your Journal.
This is home ground. You grew up on country like this.
📖 Your hands remember: knap a Stone knife (stone + vine) — the oldest tool there is. Find the stone.
📖 Your hands remember: weave cloth (3 plant fiber — strip it from cleared brush), and build a Water Filter (cloth + charcoal from fire ashes). Dirty water doesn't have to stay dirty.

You wake up with dirt in your mouth and blood on your hands that isn't yours. The sky is the wrong color — not sunset-wrong, wound-wrong. Aurora Koehler. Firefighter. From Columbus, Ohio. That was yesterday. This is now. You have: Dad's Thermos, Hoodie, Dog tags, Dispatcher's headset, Mixtape. That's everything you own in this world. Haven. Twelve people. The fire is lit. 📓 Journal: Food won't come to Haven. Walk past the treeline — learn what grows out there, bring it back, and get it named at camp.
